persona: High school English teacher managing quarterly grades
source_style: Real teacher's Excel gradebook with merged headers and embedded subtotals

columns.name: Class
columns.notes: Class label (A/B/C); values merged vertically across all students in that class (B3:B6, B8:B12, B14:B19)

columns.name: Test
columns.notes: Term 1 Test score; identical header 'Test' appears again in column E for Term 2

columns.name: Quiz
columns.notes: Term 1 Quiz score; identical header 'Quiz' appears again in column F for Term 2

columns.name: Test
columns.notes: Term 2 Test score (duplicate header name from column C)

columns.name: Quiz
columns.notes: Term 2 Quiz score (duplicate header name from column D)

columns.name: Grade
columns.notes: Final overall grade (average of tests and quizzes)

intended_analysis: Compare average performance across three classes; examine improvement from Term 1 to Term 2; identify Test vs Quiz performance patterns
mess_applied: Two-row header structure: row 1 contains merged 'Term 1' and 'Term 2' spanning two columns each; row 2 contains sub-headers
Merged cells in column B for class labels (B3:B6 for Class A, B8:B12 for Class B, B14:B19 for Class C) spanning all students in each class
Subtotal/average rows embedded between class data blocks (row 7: 'Class A Average', row 13: 'Class B Average', row 20: 'Class C Average')
Duplicate header names: 'Test' appears in both C2 (Term 1) and E2 (Term 2); 'Quiz' appears in both D2 (Term 1) and F2 (Term 2)
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong: Including subtotal rows in analysis as if they were individual students (e.g., treating 'Class A Average' as a 16th student)
Not recognizing duplicate column headers; may accidentally sum or average 'Test' columns together
Misinterpreting merged cells: assuming each student has their own class label rather than recognizing the vertical span
Flattening without respecting the two-row header; losing the Term 1/Term 2 context
Assuming all rows are uniform data rather than filtering out aggregate/subtotal rows
Reading the class value from only the first student in a merged block and missing it for subsequent rows
